answer: How far can one hand reach? Tie account attestations to postal reality: validating a voyage requires receiving, at a physical address tied to a real name, a letter holding a code printed once and read once. One person owns one mailbox; a dune of aliases demands separate mailboxes, leases, lives. The mesa of the ledger - the flat height from which every claim is visible - then exposes any farm routing ten thousand deliveries to one porch. The cost of sybiling stops being computation and becomes physical separateness, and land is the one resource no script can clone.
